text: Your game says sixty F P S, but it feels choppy.
F P S is an average.
Sixty frames in a second could arrive evenly,
one every sixteen point seven milliseconds.
Or most could arrive fast and a few late:
but your eyes notice the gaps.
It's why reviewers now show frame-time graphs and one percent lows,
and why capping your frame rate
can make a game feel smoother.
